svg.title: New Edge PDP Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of the New Edge PDP: the authorization API, OPA, health server, query and bundle loopbacks, embedded database, change ingest and NATS leaf inside one container, with Permit.io and your policy store outside it.

rect.data-composition-frame-label: New Edge PDP — one container per Permit environment
